name: OAI.PiExponent.RowTranslation.multiIndex_apply
prettyType: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] (a : σ → ℕ) (i : σ), (OAI.PiExponent.RowTranslation.multiIndex a) i = a i

name: OAI.PiExponent.RowTranslation.shifted_X_pow
prettyType:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (c : σ → R) (i : σ) (n : ℕ),
  (MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C (c i)) ^ n =
    ∑ b, MvPolynomial.C (↑(n.choose ↑b) * c i ^ (n - ↑b)) * MvPolynomial.X i ^ ↑b

name: OAI.PiExponent.RowTranslation.shifted_product_expansion
prettyType:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] (c : σ → R)
  (a : σ → ℕ),
  ∏ i, (MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C (c i)) ^ a i =
    ∑ b,
      MvPolynomial.C (∏ i, ↑((a i).choose ↑(b i)) * c i ^ (a i - ↑(b i))) *
        (MvPolynomial.monomial (OAI.PiExponent.RowTranslation.multiIndex fun i => ↑(b i))) 1

name: OAI.PiExponent.RowTranslation.shift_monomial_one
prettyType:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [inst_1 : CommSemiring R] (c : σ → R) (a : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (OAI.PiExponent.RowTranslation.shift c) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) 1) =
    ∏ i, (MvPolynomial.X i + MvPolynomial.C (c i)) ^ a i

name: OAI.PiExponent.RowTranslation.shiftCoefficient_eq
prettyType:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] (c : σ → R) (β a : σ →₀ ℕ),
  OAI.PiExponent.RowTranslation.shiftCoefficient c β a = ∏ i, ↑((a i).choose (β i)) * c i ^ (a i - β i)

name: OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.exponentVector_apply
prettyType: ∀ {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → ℕ) (i : Fin m), (OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.exponentVector a) i = a i

name: OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.entry_eq_binomial_product
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℂ) (G : Fin m → Polynomial ℂ) (j s : ℕ) (β : Fin m → ℕ) (h : ℕ) (α : Fin m → ℕ),
  OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.entry r G j s β h α =
    (∏ i, ↑((α i).choose (β i))) * ((1 + Polynomial.X) ^ h * ∏ i, (Polynomial.C (↑j * r i) + G i) ^ (α i - β i)).coeff s

name: OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.entry_eq_zero_of_not_le
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℂ) (G : Fin m → Polynomial ℂ) (j s : ℕ) (β : Fin m → ℕ) (h : ℕ) (α : Fin m → ℕ),
  (¬∀ (i : Fin m), β i ≤ α i) → OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.entry r G j s β h α = 0

name: OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.scalar_product_mul_coeff
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (q : Fin m → ℂ) (d : Fin m → ℕ) (P : Polynomial ℂ) (F : Fin m → Polynomial ℂ) (s : ℕ),
  (∏ i, q i ^ d i) * (P * ∏ i, F i ^ d i).coeff s = (P * ∏ i, (Polynomial.C (q i) * F i) ^ d i).coeff s

name: OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.gaussian_center_cast
prettyType: ∀ (j : ℕ) (p : ℤ), GaussianInt.toComplex { re := 0, im := 2 * ↑j * p } = ↑j * (2 * Complex.I * ↑p)

name: solution
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (T q e : Fin m → ℕ) (p : Fin m → ℤ),
  (∀ (i : Fin m), q i ≠ 0) →
    ∀ (j s h : ℕ) (β α : Fin m → ℕ),
      (∀ (i : Fin m), α i ≤ e i) →
        (((∏ i, ↑(T i).lcmUpto ^ e i) * ∏ i, ↑(q i) ^ α i) / ∏ i, ↑(q i) ^ β i) *
            OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.entry (fun i => 2 * Complex.I * ↑(p i) / ↑(q i))
              (fun i => OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.truncatedLog (T i)) j s β h α ∈
          GaussianInt.toComplex.range

name: OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.entry.eq_1
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℂ) (G : Fin m → Polynomial ℂ) (j s : ℕ) (b : Fin m → ℕ) (h : ℕ) (a : Fin m → ℕ),
  OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.entry r G j s b h a =
    (MvPolynomial.coeff (OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.exponentVector b)
          (OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.monomialImage r G j h a)).coeff
      s

name: OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.monomialImage.eq_1
prettyType:
∀ {m : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℂ) (G : Fin m → Polynomial ℂ) (j h : ℕ) (a : Fin m → ℕ),
  OAI.PiExponent.InterpolationMatrix.monomialImage r G j h a =
    MvPolynomial.C ((1 + Polynomial.X) ^ h) *
      ∏ i, (MvPolynomial.C (Polynomial.C (↑j * r i) + G i) + MvPolynomial.X i) ^ a i

name: OAI.PiExponent.RowTranslation.shiftCoefficient.eq_1
prettyType:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (c : σ → R) (β a : σ →₀ ℕ),
  OAI.PiExponent.RowTranslation.shiftCoefficient c β a =
    MvPolynomial.coeff β ((OAI.PiExponent.RowTranslation.shift c) ((MvPolynomial.monomial a) 1))
